summary: Hope Bancorp filed an 8-K to report Q1 2026 results and declare a $0.14/share quarterly cash dividend payable May 22, 2026, to holders of record May 8, 2026. The filing exhibits earnings release and investor presentation, with dividend as a routine capital return. No special-situation event such as M&A, activism, or restructuring is present. The dividend is ordinary and not categorized as a capital return special situation. Focus on earnings call for operational guidance.
